messages.content: Now that the Milwaukee flights are booked, compare the hotel my father-in-law suggested with the less expensive independent one. We need Friday and Saturday nights, checking out Sunday.
I’ll compare both for December 12-14 for one room and two adults. What is the retirement dinner venue, and do you have the family block details?

The dinner is Saturday at the Italian Community Center, 631 East Chicago Street. The block is at the Homewood Suites downtown under Thompson Retirement. The other place is the Plaza Hotel on Cass Street.

The family block at Homewood Suites Milwaukee Downtown has a king studio available at $189 per night. For two nights, the room is $378. Estimated taxes are $66.91, and self-parking is $30 per night, making the complete stay $504.91. The block rate can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. on Wednesday, December 10; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. The hotel is about a 5-minute drive or 12-minute walk from the Italian Community Center.
And the Plaza? Their nightly price looked quite a bit lower.

The Plaza has a queen suite at $159 per night. Two nights are $318, estimated taxes are $56.29, and overnight parking is $25 per night. The full total is $424.29. Cancellation is free until 3:00 p.m. on Tuesday, December 9; later cancellation or a no-show is charged the full two-night room amount plus tax. Travel to the dinner venue is about 9 minutes by car in ordinary traffic and roughly 28 minutes on foot.
So the real difference is $80.62, including parking?
Correct. Homewood Suites is $504.91 all-in, while the Plaza is $424.29 all-in, so the Plaza is $80.62 less for the two-night stay.
Does either total include breakfast? Also, are both rooms still available for two people?

Both quoted rooms are currently available for two adults. Homewood Suites includes a hot breakfast for both guests. The Plaza does not include breakfast; its on-site cafe is priced separately. Both rooms include Wi-Fi, and neither requires prepayment today.
The family will be gathering at the Homewood before dinner, and I don’t want us dealing with a separate ride if the weather is bad. Is the room block about to close?

Yes. The Thompson Retirement block is scheduled to close at 11:59 p.m. Central tomorrow, after which the $189 rate is no longer protected. The hotel may still have rooms later, but they would be sold at the prevailing rate.
Then the Homewood makes more sense even at the higher total. Please reserve the king studio for Morgan and me, December 12 through 14, and use the card ending in 1842 to guarantee it.

Before I submit it: one king studio at Homewood Suites Milwaukee Downtown for Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson, check-in Friday, December 12, checkout Sunday, December 14. The estimated total is $504.91 including taxes and two nights of self-parking. No charge is due now; the card ending in 1842 will guarantee the room. Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. Central on December 10, followed by a one-night-plus-tax penalty. Shall I complete the reservation?

Reserved. Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson are confirmed in one king studio at Homewood Suites Milwaukee Downtown for December 12-14, two nights, under the Thompson Retirement block. The estimated total is $504.91, including taxes and self-parking for both nights. The card ending in 1842 guarantees the stay and was not charged today. Free cancellation remains available until 6:00 p.m. Central on December 10; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. Hotel confirmation: HMW-638517.
